title: Ordinary and geometric etale costalk functors
statement: Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring and $X$ a scheme. Work in small etale bounded-below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For $z\in X$, let $j_z:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,z}\to X$ and let $i_z:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(z)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,z}$ be the residue quotient closed immersion [def-weil-residue-field], [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Define $C_z=j_z^*i_z^!$ in application order: $C_z(K)=i_z^!(j_z^*K)$, where $i_z^!$ is the right derived supported inverse image of [def-pur-etale-supported-kernel], equivalently the closed right adjoint specified by [lem-per-ind-etale-closed-support-base-change]. For a geometric point $\bar z:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ [def-weil-geometric-point], define $C_{\bar z}(K)$ to be the derived geometric stalk of $C_z(K)$ along the induced residue-field embedding [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Define also the comparison target $R\Gamma_{\{z_0\}}(X_{(\bar z)},K|_{X_{(\bar z)}})$ using the canonical strict localization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] and the supported-sections functor [def-pur-etale-derived-supported-sections]. No comparison is asserted in this definition.
